personality_one_liner: A friendly, stress-free financial companion that feels like organizing your desk with colorful, rounded blocks.

spacing.rule: Generous touch targets. Maintain consistent padding around cards (at least 16pt/lg) so it doesn't feel cramped. No orphans.

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Smooth onboarding with Email or Google login.

states.error: Toast or inline text under inputs

screens.layout: Hero image at the top covering 40% of screen with abstract calm green background and gradient scrim. Clean pill-shaped inputs, large brandPrimary CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Dashboard (Home)
screens.purpose: A quick, stress-free snapshot of total monthly spend and upcoming renewals.

states.empty: Friendly paper box illustration 'Belum ada langganan. Yuk tambah sekarang!' with a prominent 'Add Subscription' CTA

screens.layout: Header with greeting. Top card: large total spend figure (Rp) with brand background and subtle noise texture. Middle section: 'Mendekati Jatuh Tempo' (Upcoming due in 7 days) highlighted in tactile cards. Bottom: Simple Category Spend visualization (horizontal stacked bar or colorful chips).

screens.name: Subscription List
screens.purpose: Comprehensive view of all subscriptions with easy filtering.
screens.layout: Sticky header with glassmorphism containing horizontal scrollable filter pills (All, Entertainment, Productivity, Active, Trial). List items as chunky rounded cards (md radius, shadow tier 2) containing the subscription logo, name, next billing date, and Rp cost. FAB at bottom right to add.

screens.name: Add/Edit Subscription
screens.purpose: Form to input subscription details like name, cost, and cycle.
screens.layout: Single column form inside a KeyboardAvoidingView. Labels above inputs. Sticky 'Simpan' CTA at the bottom above safe area.

screens.name: Freemium Modal
screens.layout: Bottom sheet modal using @gorhom/bottom-sheet. Playful illustration at top, bold value prop ('Unlimited subs + WA reminders'), large pill primary CTA 'Upgrade ke Premium'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Adhere strictly to the 'Tactile / Playful' layout: use chunky cards, generous padding, and pill-shaped interactive elements. Never make the UI look like a rigid corporate banking app.
For the main Dashboard card, use the 'brand' color background with a subtle noise or linear gradient to give it depth.
Implement the 'Freemium gating modal' using @gorhom/bottom-sheet. It should trigger when the user attempts to add a 4th subscription and currently has a 'free' status.
Apply Glassmorphism heavily on sticky headers and the bottom tab bar to create depth, but maintain WCAG accessibility by ensuring proper tint overlay behind the blur.

For rendering subscription logos (e.g. Netflix, Spotify), use the provided Unsplash URLs inside a rounded container (md or lg radius) with overflow: hidden to make the photographic backgrounds look like intentional app icons.
Ensure the empty states on the Dashboard and Subscription list use the 'empty_state_box' image, positioned centrally with a friendly Indonesian copy ('Belum ada langganan...').
Use Phosphor icons. Stick to consistent weights (e.g. filled for active states, regular for inactive).
Make sure forms have labels ABOVE inputs, not floating. Use sticky CTAs anchored at the bottom with keyboard avoiding views.
